bffUnavailable: Navigation BFF unavailable, using local fallback.

scenarioChooser.title: What do you want to integrate?
scenarioChooser.description: Choose a working scenario. OMH will create or suggest low-level routes, steps and keys under the hood.

router.title: Choose a wizard by scenario
router.input: A real task description: who calls, what arrives and what should happen
router.output: Recommended pattern, step plan and the right wizard/workbench
router.does: OMH classifies the scenario and opens the right wizard without endpoint/route/workflow jargon.
router.best: Default start for a new integration.

odata.title: Test 1C OData
odata.input: Inbound request fields or manual filter
odata.output: Found fields, JSON sample or an integration step
odata.does: OMH guides connection, resource, $select/$filter and saving the result.
odata.best: Finding orders, contractors, stock or tabular-section rows.

flows.title: View published integrations
flows.output: Endpoint, trigger key, steps, final action and test curl
flows.does: Shows what is really published and what the caller will receive.
flows.best: Checking setup results or preparing for a production test.

events.title: Check execution
events.output: Timeline, errors, requests, responses and repeat diagnostics
events.does: Opens the event journal so you can see what happened after an endpoint call.
events.best: Troubleshooting an error or confirming successful synchronization.
